profile:
## John

**Identity/work:** Professional basketball player, shooting guard for the Minnesota Wolves; signed May 2023 and had played professionally for just under a year by December. Basketball has been central since childhood: his father introduced him to NBA games and enrolled him in a local league at age 10; John later played through school, earned a college scholarship, and was drafted. He trains daily, combining basketball, strength work, yoga and rehabilitation. He mentors younger players and gives sports/marketing seminars.

**Relationships/family:** Married his girlfriend in an intimate greenhouse ceremony in late September 2023; they honeymooned/traveled in Europe. Family is supportive and gathers frequently; teammates are a “second family.” Friends include Tim, Anthony, hiking-club members and teammates.

**Interests/possessions:** Basketball, jerseys, lucky shoes, cooking, reading, movies, restaurants, travel, hiking, camping, surfing (since about 2018), oceans and nature, language learning (some German and Spanish; studying Spanish), and Harry Potter. Owns the complete Harry Potter films, a bookshelf including *The Alchemist*, a motivational plaque and an Aragorn painting. Favorite team: Wolves; admires LeBron James. Enjoys *The Lord of the Rings*, especially Aragorn, and fantasy books. No pets mentioned.

**Values/goals:** Resilience, perseverance, teamwork, self-improvement, family and meaningful leadership. Wants better shooting, consistent performance, a championship and greater on-court impact. Seeks authentic endorsements and a post-basketball legacy through charity, youth sports, fair opportunities and perhaps a foundation. Signed Nike and an outdoor-gear deal; discussed Gatorade, Under Armour and later a beverage endorsement.

**Timeline:** May 21 2023—joined Wolves; targeted shooting improvement. July—career-high 40 points; signed Nike. Aug—won close games, found a new gym, visited family/NYC, and celebrated teammates. Oct—married; team won a trophy. Nov—European trip and injury. Dec—rehabilitation, career-high assists (Dec 8), benefit/community work, seminars and outdoor endorsement. Dec 2023—visited Italy. Jan 2 2024—continued daily training; Jan 12—secured a beverage deal.

## Tim

**Identity/work/studies:** Student focused on school, literature and projects. Writes fantasy-novel articles for an online magazine and is writing a fantasy novel; also joined fantasy-literature and travel groups. Studied for exams using 25-minute work periods and five-minute breaks. No sports-team experience reported.

**Relationships/family:** Values supportive friends and family; watched *Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone* with family and enjoys family meals, Thanksgiving movies and holiday traditions. Close friendship with John. No pets mentioned.

**Interests/possessions:** Avid fantasy reader and collector with Harry Potter books, a themed Christmas tree, MinaLima memorabilia and a large bookshelf. Favorite works/interests include Harry Potter, *Game of Thrones*, *The Hobbit*, *The Name of the Wind*, *The Lord of the Rings*, Star Wars and *A Dance with Dragons*; enjoys movies, marathons, board games, reading, writing, road trips, hiking, travel, castles and photography. Learning piano and violin; interested in classical music, jazz and film scores. Learning German; previously studied French. Owns a LeBron James-signed basketball. No pets mentioned.

**Values/goals:** Imagination, hope, perseverance, creativity, belonging and learning. Fantasy offers escape and connection. Inspired by J.K. Rowling, Emma Watson’s gender-equality advocacy and LeBron James’s determination. Wants to travel widely, visit castles, Italy, Paris and New York, study abroad in Ireland, and develop his writing.

**Timeline:** May–June 2023—Harry Potter project and fantasy forum. Aug—began magazine articles, attended fan activities and learned piano. Oct—attended a UK Harry Potter conference and began a fantasy novel. Nov—exams and writing set
